description: The top-left plot in Figure 6, titled “Massive Activation of baseline,” illustrates the maximum activation values across 22 layers for four components: `attn_output` (blue dashed line), `attn_residual` (orange dotted line), `ffn_output` (green dash-dot line), and `ffn_residual` (red solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 22 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with tick marks at intervals of 200. All four lines remain near zero through layer 5. Starting at layer 6, `ffn_residual` (red solid) sharply increases to approximately 1600 and remains flat until layer 20, after which it drops sharply. `attn_residual` (orange dotted) follows a similar pattern, rising to about 1500 at layer 6 and staying elevated until layer 20. `ffn_output` (green dash-dot) shows a smaller, delayed spike around layer 10, peaking near 1200, then dropping. `attn_output` (blue dashed) remains close to zero throughout all layers. The caption indicates this represents the baseline configuration, where significant massive activations emerge after the 6th layer.
